title: Settings
subtitle: Manage your personal account and preferences
accountHint: This information applies to you only and is visible to colleagues.
completenessHint: Add a photo, job title, department and phone number so colleagues can find and reach you.
appPrefsHint: Saved to your account — they follow you across devices.
connectionsHint: Whether your account is linked to the systems that feed your absences and activity.
clockodoDirect: Linked directly — your absences sync automatically.
clockodoViaPerson: Linked via your ActivityTrack record — your absences sync automatically.
clockodoUnlinkedHint: Ask an admin to link your Clockodo account so absences sync.
personUnlinkedHint: No ActivityTrack person record is linked to you yet.
avatarPreviewHint: Your photo is cropped to a square and resized automatically.
